description:
Valor Mortis has all the makings of your typical Souls-like, but this time you’re playing in first-person as a soldier who was once a part of Napoleon’s army. Playing a game from the creators of Ghostrunner that’s set in an entirely different genre can have a steep learning curve, even if you’re a parrying pro. To make sure you’re set up for success, here are 8 things you should know before playing Valor Mortis.

00:00 - Intro
00:30 - Combat 101
02:25 - Weak Points
03:38 - Consumables
04:28 - Catalyst Farming
05:08 - Side Quests
06:13 - Weapon & Flask Upgrades
07:57 - Traversal

description:
Take a look at the Official Announcement Trailer for Silk & Sorrow, a hand-drawn dark fantasy co-op adventure built exclusively for two players. Start your journey in Winter 2027 when a demo featuring Chapter 1 arrives.

The game tells the story of two orphans, Silk and Sorrow, who stumble into the Chrysalis, a hidden world where everything humanity has discarded ends up. Together, they must explore a haunting landscape built from the forgotten remnants of the world above, survive its twisted horrors and corrupted inhabitants, and bring light back to the Chrysalis. Guiding them through the darkness is Glint the Glowgrub, a small but vital companion whose glow lights the way.

Silk & Sorrow can be played in both couch co-op and online co-op, with players needing to communicate, solve problems, and trust one another to survive a world where every step brings new dangers and unsettling discoveries.

Silk & Sorrow is coming to PC via Steam, with Chapter 1 releasing as a demo in Winter 202

author: IGN
description:
Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse reviewed by Scott White on PlayStation 5, also available on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.
"Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse brings Konami’s beloved series into the modern era with a fast-paced / action-focused adventure. Convenient map tracking tools, exciting combat, a great new hero, and movement tech that will test your reflexes all help this long-awaited sequel stand tall in what has since become a crowded genre. But Belmont’s Curse is a better metroidvania generally than it is a Castlevania specifically, sacrificing some of the series’ signature charm and feel along the way. Even still, I would not be upset to see developer Evil Empire’s name attached to another Castlevania game in the future. I just hope it doesn’t take another 18 years to arrive – I don’t think my reflexes will be up to the task when I hit my mid-50s."
title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Review

author: IGN
description:
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve reviewed by Will Borger on PC and Xbox Series X, also available on Xbox Series S and PS5.

"Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is a remarkable achievement for Project Aces. Its campaign combines stunning visuals and sound design with engaging story moments both out-of-the-cockpit and over radio chatter that build up its excellent, memorable characters. It's also a surprisingly emotional and resonant story that's deeply relevant to the current age while delivering the best aerial combat the series has ever had with some of its best mission design. I haven’t been able to stop thinking about it since I stepped out of the cockpit, and I know the Wings of Theve, and their story, will stick with me for a very long time. For now, perhaps it's enough to hope for a world free of nations and war, one where we soar the skies freely for ourselves. And like the Wings of Theve, by believing in it, maybe we can make it real."
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Review
